name: PriceTag
description: A paper price tag that drops in on its string and swings to rest, with an optional label and an old price that gets struck through. For a price that changed, or what something really costs.

old.description: the old price, struck through at strike_at

label.description: small line on top: Large latte

at.description: Time the tag drops in: "line:6" or seconds from the clip start. Default: the clip start

strike_at.description: Time the old price is struck: "line:7" or seconds from the clip start. Default: 0.7 s after at

color.description: price and strike colour: theme token or CSS
